catalog.ask.body1: Ask AGRO-AI works like an experienced colleague who can read your records. Try a question such as:
catalog.ask.body_with_data: Answers draw on the records you have connected and show what they are based on.
catalog.ask.body_without_data: Until you connect field records, answers rely on general agronomic knowledge, and AGRO-AI tells you when it needs your data to be specific.
catalog.ask.example1: Which fields should we prioritize for irrigation this week?
catalog.ask.example2: What changed in our water use compared with last month?
catalog.ask.example3: What evidence do we still need for our next compliance report?
catalog.ask.headline: Ask the questions you deal with every day
catalog.ask.preview: Start with a question you would ask an agronomist or irrigation manager.
catalog.ask.subject: Ask AGRO-AI about your operation
catalog.common.button_fallback: If the button does not work, copy this link into your browser:
catalog.common.reason: You are receiving this email because you created an AGRO-AI account for {organization}.
catalog.common.unsubscribe_note: Account, security, and billing emails are not affected.
catalog.connect_data.body1: AGRO-AI does not ask you to replace your controllers, sensors, or spreadsheets. It reads from them. Upload an irrigation log, a controller export, or a field record, or connect a supported system.
catalog.connect_data.body2: Once your data is in, recommendations, readiness checks, and reports are based on your operation rather than general guidance.
catalog.connect_data.headline: Work with the information you already have
catalog.connect_data.preview: Use the systems and files you already have. Nothing needs to be replaced.
catalog.connect_data.subject: Bring your field records into AGRO-AI
catalog.connectors.body1: Most operations already run several systems: irrigation controllers, weather data, field records, and shared documents. AGRO-AI connects to them so the information is in one place.
catalog.connectors.body_free: On the Free plan you can import files directly. Live connections are included from the Professional plan.
catalog.connectors.body_paid: Your plan includes live connections. Each one you add makes recommendations and reports more complete.
catalog.connectors.headline: Built to work with your existing systems
catalog.connectors.preview: AGRO-AI sits on top of your existing controllers and records.
catalog.connectors.subject: Connect AGRO-AI to the systems you already use
catalog.field.body1: When someone in the field spots uneven emergence, a leak, or stress in a block, Field Intelligence lets them record it on the spot: a voice note, photos, a short description, and the location.
catalog.field.body2: Observations are saved even without a connection and sync when the device is back online, so your team keeps a dated record tied to the field instead of a message lost in a group chat.
catalog.field.headline: Turn field walks into usable records
catalog.field.preview: Record observations by voice, photo, or text, even without a signal.
catalog.field.subject: Capture what you see in the field
catalog.market.body1: Market Intelligence keeps your crop positions, contracted volumes, and open exposure in one view, so marketing and planning decisions are based on current numbers rather than memory.
catalog.market.body2: Record your positions and contracts to see how much of each crop is covered, where you are exposed, and keep a decision journal your team can refer back to.
catalog.market.headline: From crop information to commercial decisions
catalog.market.preview: Crop positions, contracted volumes, and open exposure together.
catalog.market.subject: See your crop positions in one place
catalog.plans.body1: The Free plan is meant for trying AGRO-AI in a single workspace. When you rely on it for day-to-day operations, the Professional plan adds:
catalog.plans.body2: Team and Network plans add team invitations, shared workspaces, and multi-site reporting for larger operations.
catalog.plans.headline: What changes when you move beyond Free
catalog.plans.item_ask: Ask AGRO-AI, with {pro_messages} questions a month answered from your records
catalog.plans.item_uploads: {pro_uploads} evidence uploads a month instead of {free_uploads}
catalog.plans.preview: What changes on the Professional plan, in plain numbers.

catalog.team.body1: Your plan includes {seats} seats. Invite the people who make or carry out field decisions, such as irrigators, agronomists, and farm managers, and give each the role they need.
catalog.team.headline: Work from the same records as your team
catalog.team.preview: Field staff, agronomists, and managers can work from the same records.
catalog.team.subject: Bring your team into AGRO-AI

catalog.welcome.body1: Your account for {organization} is ready. AGRO-AI is most useful once it understands your operation: your fields and blocks, the crops you manage, and the records you already keep.
catalog.welcome.body2: Start by reviewing your workspace and adding what you know about the operation. It takes a few minutes and makes every answer more specific to your fields.
catalog.welcome.headline: Welcome to AGRO-AI
catalog.welcome.preview: Set up your operation so AGRO-AI can work with your fields, water, and records.
